final: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film GROUP BY rating), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall FROM r) SELECT r.rating, r.avg_ratio, r.film_count, r.avg_ratio / o.overall AS ratio_to_overall FROM r JOIN o ON o.overall IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.rating
